text:
Alicia M: Heads-up — opened a PR to update the KMS rotation policy used by secrets-service. Need a security review + approval before Friday EOD so we can hit the weekend merge window. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4822 :eyes:
Ben T: sending :eyes: — quick q: will this affect on-prem HSM flows or only cloud KMS endpoints?
Alicia M: only cloud KMS; on-prem HSM path uses the vault adapter. I added a note in the PR about HSM non-impact.
Carol S: I can take this today, won't be long. ping me if you add a sample policy snippet in the PR — helps audits. :thumbsup:
Dave R: FYI we should coordinate with release-control for the merge window — any downtime for secrets-service?
Alicia M: no downtime expected. changes are metadata-only (rotation schedule, retention tagging). no key material changes. merge window just to keep coincident small deploys grouped.
MergeBot: CI report: 2 checks failed — integration-tests/secrets-mgmt, lint. See https://ci.company/4822/build/99
Brad L: integration-tests flaked on env setup last run, probably transient. will rerun once tests are fixed.
Ben T: can you paste the JSON snippet you added for the rotation policy? auditors like to see exact TTL + rotation window.
Alicia M: sure — added below in the PR description, pasted here for quick eyes:
```
{
  "kms_key_alias": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/secrets-kr/cryptoKeys/keyshelf-01",
  "rotation": {
    "rotation_period_days": 90,
    "next_rotation": "2026-04-10T03:00:00Z",
    "auto_rotate": true
  },
  "tags": ["secrets-service","automated-rotation","audited"]
}
```
Carol S: looks good. please add a comment that rotation events are logged to audit-log with key_id + requestor (we need that for compliance). Also add an ACL check snippet to the PR where you enforce the service account can only use Encrypt/Decrypt but not Import.
Alicia M: added audit-log note and the ACL snippet (see PR). small follow-up: does anyone want to take the ACL code quick review? cc @Carol S @Dave R
Dave R: i'll glance at it — mainly want to ensure we don't accidentally remove admin bindings in the keyring.
Carol S: left a couple inline comments requesting explicit deny for import and a link to the KMS hardening doc. once those are addressed i can approve.
Alicia M: addressed comments and pushed commit 7f8b2c8. i've also retried CI.
MergeBot: CI report: all checks passed. build/100 ✅
Carol S: lgtm with the deny-import change and audit note included. approving. :white_check_mark:
Brad L: approving as well, no infra blockers.
Alicia M: thanks all — i'll merge during the Friday 10:00-11:00 UTC merge window and notify release-control. Appreciate the quick review! :raised_hands:
